messages:
hana: Hey team — quick brain dump: rooftop game + craft-soda tasting next Fri 6/4 7pm? small group, bring one portable game and a bottle of something non-alcoholic to share. theme: "odd sodas". whos up? :tumbler_glass: :game_die:

omar: love the theme. i'm in. can bring a travel Azul and a few unusual ginger sodas.

leah: i'm in if it's not too late. 7pm works. i can bring a two-player game and napkins.

ryan: depends on train times but trying to make it. can someone start a tiny signup to avoid duplicates?

marta: i'm remote that day but would love a photo dump. also happy to contribute $5 to a shared snack pot.

lunchbot: Poll created: "Start time" options: 6:30pm, 7:00pm, 7:30pm  vote with :one: :two: :three:. (poll id 10123)

eventbot: Note: rooftop reservation requires headcount <=12, no open flames. (eventbot)

omar: voted :two: (7:00)

leah: voted :two: (7:00)

hana: voted :one: (6:30) but fine with majority.

ryan: voted :two: (7:00) — i'll aim for 7:00.

hana: OK looks like 7pm wins. @marta thanks for the snack contribution offer  i'll DM Venmo. @omar please add ginger sodas to the sheet, i'll add a note to bring a cooler. link: https://tiny.redwood/odd-sodas (placeholder)

leah: remote folks: we'll set up a tablet on a stand so you can watch a round and shout recommendations. also will keep a slot for a quick remote-friendly game (Skribbl/Jackbox).

marta: perfect, i'll tune in! can someone save a fun pic for me pls? :pleading_face:

hana: final plan: rooftop 7pm, bring a game + bottle, small shared snack tab $5 suggested. i'll reserve the rooftop bench area. if rain -> move to lobby lounge.

eventbot: Reservation confirmed: Redwood - Rooftop Bench A, 7:00pm, max 12. Rain backup: Lobby Lounge. (eventbot)

omar: i'll bring Azul + 2 ginger sodas. leah, i'll grab napkins too.

leah: thanks Omar! i'll bring fruit skewers and extra solo cups.

ryan: bringing a tiny travel Codenames. see you Friday!

hana: reminder set: "Odd Sodas & Games" Fri 2026-06-04 18:00. (local)

marta: can't wait. sending a virtual cheers in advance :clinking_glasses:

leah: cute theme, see you all soon :smile:"
